<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_875435_nowflix.MediaFilterUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>MediaFilterUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var MediaFilterUtils = Class.create();
MediaFilterUtils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    getMediasWithoutReviews: function() {
        var mediasWithReviews = [];
        
        // 1. Buscar todos os registros na tabela de reviews (ex: u_media_review)
        // Substitua 'u_media_review' e 'u_media' pelos nomes reais das suas tabelas/campos
        var reviewGR = new GlideRecord('x_875435_nowflix_review');
        reviewGR.query();
        
        while (reviewGR.next()) {
            mediasWithReviews.push(reviewGR.getValue('media')); // Campo que referencia a Media
        }

        // 2. Retornar query: sys_id NÃO ESTÁ NA lista de mídias que possuem reviews
        if (mediasWithReviews.length > 0) {
            return "sys_idNOT IN" + mediasWithReviews.join(',');
        }
        
        // Se não houver reviews, retorna tudo (ou active=true)
        return "active=true";
    },

    type: 'MediaFilterUtils'
});
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-22 14:34:29</sys_created_on><sys_id>480f6a539398075039d0367efaba109f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>MediaFilterUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Nowflix" source="x_875435_nowflix">0a71d1569300c31039d0367efaba1001</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Nowflix">0a71d1569300c31039d0367efaba1001</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_480f6a539398075039d0367efaba109f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-22 14:39:18</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
